release.note: Release dates are targets, not promises. The public beta stays available while the next releases are prepared.

following.name: Study, Connect & Prepare
following.summary: A more personal and collaborative Hub: bring your study tools together, expand reviewed learning resources and prepare for the next destination.

vision.title: Towards the full Student Hub
vision.note: The release count records improvements already published. The full Hub remains a longer-term plan for Spring 2027; upcoming dates may change with student feedback.

planningNote: Dates are estimates, not promises. v2.0 targets early November, with further improvements released in stages. Next items may progress together; After launch and Later ideas do not yet have a delivery date.

lanes.title: Now
lanes.description: What the Student Hub team is working on right now.

lanes.title: Next
lanes.description: Planned work, grouped by the period we expect to deliver it.

lanes.title: Later
lanes.description: Larger ideas we are exploring. No dates yet.

items.title: Exam Prep
items.summary: Expand and review exam-style practice across semester 1, building on the live FHEM Exam Centre, statistics practice and existing question banks.
items.why: Practise in the format of the real exams, at your own pace, before the first exam period.
details: Add reviewed practice for courses and topics that still need broader coverage before the exam period that starts on 26 October.
Build on the live timed mocks, flashcards and question banks, with explanations and correction reporting.
Keep revision progress on the student's own device.
dependencies: Reviewed questions for each course, written by students.

items.title: Beta feedback & essential improvements
items.summary: Turn cohort feedback into focused improvements to navigation, accessibility and the study workflows students use most.
items.why: Spend development time on the problems students meet in real use.
details: Review feedback on the redesigned Announcements bulletin, the supplied-data cohort atlas and the expanded Student Toolkit.
Fix confusing steps and prioritise practical improvements for mobile and keyboard use.
Keep the public release history and planned feature states aligned with what students can actually use.
dependencies: Feedback from the first student beta (coming in since 7 October 2026).

items.title: Cohort-only accounts & profiles
items.summary: Sign-in for verified EU-HEM students, a private cohort space and real student profiles, with clear choices about who can see each profile.
items.why: Make it easier to connect with classmates while you stay in control of what you share.
details: Offer public, cohort-only and unpublished profile choices, as described on the privacy page.
Check EU-HEM membership before showing anything cohort-only, with controls to edit or remove a profile.
Replace the current fictional directory preview only when registration and privacy controls are ready.
dependencies: A working registration service, verified access and reviewed profile-sharing controls.
items.note: Needs a secure sign-in and a privacy review first.

items.title: Custom domain & admin dashboard
items.summary: Complete the custom-domain move and activate the prepared editor dashboard, so approved editors can maintain announcements and events.
items.why: Keep important information easier to find, correct and maintain as the Hub grows.
details: The editor screens are built, including review tools, events, team administration and backups; live publishing is still being prepared.
Choose and connect the custom domain, with redirects and clear guidance for existing saved settings.
Complete editor access, review responsibilities and a live publishing check before activation.
dependencies: A domain decision, a working publishing service and verified editor access.
items.note: Editor tools are prepared; live activation and the custom domain remain in progress.

items.title: v2.0 — Study, Connect & Prepare
items.summary: An initial November release that brings personal study tools together, expands reviewed learning content and makes student contributions easier.
items.why: Help students move from finding information to organising their studies and sharing useful knowledge with the cohort.
details: A personal study overview connecting selected courses, upcoming deadlines, saved resources and learning progress on this device.
A first batch of additional student-made worked examples, summaries and revision activities, guided by feedback.
An easier route for classmates to submit original notes, experiences and corrections for review before publication.
Connect the study overview with destination preparation and the first mobility checklists.
Target the initial v2 release for early November; further content and refinements can follow during the month.
dependencies: Prioritised student feedback, reviewed contributions and integration with the existing public study tools.
items.note: Initial target: early November. Accounts and cross-device sync are separate later rollouts.

items.title: More notes, summaries & interactive lessons
items.summary: Continue expanding reviewed notes, summaries, worked examples and interactive lessons across courses, beyond the first v2 content batch.
items.why: Give students more ways to understand difficult topics and revise at their own pace.
details: Fill remaining course and topic gaps identified by students, building on the existing health economics, statistics and quantitative methods material.
Add student-made summaries, worked examples, diagrams and short interactive explanations where they help.
Keep official lectures and course materials on Virtuale, and link to them.
dependencies: Student contributors, topic priorities and content review.

items.title: More quizzes, flashcards & question banks
items.summary: Continue growing the existing flashcards, quizzes and mock exams with reviewed revision content for more courses and topics.
items.why: Help students check their understanding and practise the topics that need another look.
details: Build on the current course question banks and timed practice with further sets after the first v2 batch.
Add clear explanations and short quizzes linked to the learning goals of each topic.
Use student feedback to correct unclear questions and prioritise gaps.
dependencies: Reviewed questions and explanations for each topic added.

items.title: Beyond EU-HEM: careers & opportunities
items.summary: A new section for jobs, internships, research opportunities, career preparation and further study.
items.why: Help students discover possible next steps and reach the original opportunity details.
details: Organise jobs, internships and research opportunities by type, location and area of interest.
Add career preparation resources, and further study and PhD opportunities where useful.
Show the source, deadline, eligibility and the date each listing was last checked; archive expired ones.
dependencies: Reliable opportunity sources and a regular review routine.

items.title: Group trips & adventures
items.summary: Explore new countries together through shared day trips, weekend adventures and student-organised activities.
items.why: Create shared experiences and make it easy for new students to join in.
details: Share a proposed destination, activity, date and approximate budget.
Gather interest and agree a simple plan with the organiser.
Link each trip to useful transport and local information.
dependencies: Student organisers and clear choices about sharing who takes part.

items.title: Personal mobility checklists
items.summary: Build destination-specific checklists for the next EU-HEM move, with practical steps before departure and after arrival.
items.why: Keep track of practical tasks during a busy move.
details: Start with housing, travel and arrival tasks for each destination, with a first set targeted for v2.
Link each administrative step to official guidance and show when it was checked.
Save checklist progress on this device; the current Toolkit mobility collection already provides a useful starting set of links.
dependencies: Reviewed destination guidance that is kept current.

items.title: Budgeting & shared expenses
items.summary: A simple way to plan a student budget and keep track of shared costs.
items.why: Understand your spending and make group costs easier to settle.
details: Plan a monthly budget with your own categories.
Track shared trip or flat expenses and who has already paid.
Keep any cost examples dated and separate from personal entries.
dependencies: Student feedback on the simplest useful version.

items.title: Revision workspace across devices
items.summary: Sync study lists, revision progress and saved topics between your phone and computer.
items.why: Continue where you left off, whichever device you use.
details: Build on today's study list and progress tools, which stay on one device.
Let students choose what to sync, with export and delete controls.
Keep revision working when the connection drops.
dependencies: Student accounts and reliable controls for personal study data.

items.title: Group project workspace
items.summary: Tasks, milestones and useful links for a student project, in one shared place.
items.why: Make it easier for classmates to share responsibilities and follow progress.
details: Create a small project space with members, tasks and deadlines.
Link shared documents and the relevant course resources.
See the next tasks at a glance.
dependencies: Verified group membership and a simple collaboration model.

items.title: Research reading & reference workspace
items.summary: A place to organise papers, reading notes and sources for a research question.
items.why: Keep the reasoning behind a literature review easy to find and revisit.
details: Save citation details and links to the original publications.
Record questions, methods, findings and limitations in one reading template.
Organise references by topic and export notes.
dependencies: A focused workflow that works with existing reference managers.

items.title: Thesis timeline & supervisor meeting planner
items.summary: Extend the existing Thesis Explorer planner with a dated milestone timeline and a structured record of supervisor meetings.
items.why: The thesis is the biggest piece of independent work in EU-HEM; a clear plan makes it calmer.
details: Build on the research guide, checklists, personal drafts and backups already available in the Thesis Explorer.
Explore a dated timeline for agreed milestones, next actions and supervisor meeting notes.
Link each planning step to the relevant official deadlines and rules.
dependencies: Confirmed thesis timelines and feedback on the existing planner.

links.label: Use the current thesis guide and planner

items.title: Career application tracker
items.summary: A personal overview of the opportunities you apply to, with deadlines and next steps.
items.why: Reduce the effort of following several applications at once.
details: Save an opportunity with its source, deadline and application status.
Track next actions, interviews and follow-ups.
Link to CV, cover-letter and interview resources.
dependencies: The Beyond EU-HEM section and private storage for personal notes.

items.title: Alumni mentoring & skills exchange
items.summary: Connect students and alumni who want to share experience, answer questions or exchange skills.
items.why: Find someone who can help with a specific study, mobility or career question.
details: Volunteers describe the topics or skills they are happy to help with.
Explore matching for short conversations, peer learning or mentoring.
Participants control their contact details and availability.
dependencies: Volunteers, verified profiles and clear contact preferences.

milestones.title: First code
milestones.summary: The first homepage and project structure were written, laying the foundations of the Student Hub.

milestones.title: The first version goes online
milestones.summary: The first homepage and live timetable were published on the web.

milestones.title: A new look and the Students explorer
milestones.summary: The Students explorer (with fictional demo profiles) and a complete redesign of the Hub went live.

milestones.title: First cohort beta
milestones.summary: EU-HEM students were invited to explore the beta. Their feedback decides the next improvements.

milestones.title: Public Launch v1.0 — custom domain and dashboard
milestones.summary: The Hub opens to everyone at its own web address, with an editor dashboard. A target date, not a promise.

milestones.title: v2.0 — Study, Connect & Prepare
milestones.summary: Targeting a more personal study overview, additional reviewed learning content, student contributions and mobility preparation.

limitations.title: Known limitations
items: The country-of-origin atlas uses the supplied aggregate class counts: 105 people from 24 countries. Individual directory profiles are still fictional demos.
Personal settings, saved tools and lists, study plans and learning progress stay on this device and browser. Accounts and cross-device sync are not live.
Editors cannot yet publish through the dashboard. Announcements continue to come from the existing class Sheet.

domainMove.title: Moving to a new domain
items: A custom domain is planned. Redirects and existing shared links will be checked as part of that move.
Saved settings belong to each web address. Use the available backup or export options for study plans, personal lists and drafts before moving; some settings may need to be set again.
